newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Alpha Credit Bank plans share capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Greek Alpha Credit Bank plans share capital increase.

text.p: Greece's private Alpha Credit Bank is planning a share capital increase, its chairman Yannis Costopoulos told reporters in a news conference to unveil two new fixed-rate loans.
"We are planning something. The time is coming," said Costopoulos. "We have a tradition every three years (to increase our share capital)."
Alpha Credit Bank is going to offer two new loans at a fixed rate of 14 percent for commercial building and working capital for small industry, said Costopoulos.
